savedReplies.label: Quick replies
savedReplies.help: Inbox › Quick replies: saved answers with a short name, in English and in Bengali. Type / and the short name in a chat's reply box to put the text in. A quick reply is never deleted, only archived. "Longest text" is how many letters one may hold.

commentDesk.label: Comment desk
commentDesk.help: Inbox › Comments: Facebook and Instagram comments in one list. Optional rules: hide a comment that carries a phone number, hide abusive words, and send one private message and one public reply to a comment that asks a price or size. The words and texts are yours to set. Hiding and replying go through the Page's connection (a practice stand-in until its keys are typed in).

liveSelling.label: Live selling
liveSelling.help: Inbox › Comments › Live selling: while a live session runs, a comment like "P1 L 2 pcs" is read as a product code, a size and a quantity. "Make draft" puts the piece in that person's chat bag; staff always confirm by a call, then press Create order in the chat. "Most pieces in one comment" is the largest quantity read as an order.
